$comment: MCPW6: the bundled MCP server templates. Every version is exact and was checked on the date beside it; nothing here is fetched at run time. Field names follow the MCP Registry server.json (packages[].registryType, identifier, version, runtimeHint, runtimeArguments, packageArguments, environmentVariables, isRequired, isSecret, format, valueHint, default). To look for newer versions, run `node scripts/check-mcp-templates.mjs` (dev only, uses the network).
